questions.question: What do you need from me to get started?
questions.answer: Your manuscript (Word or Google Docs), the trim size if you know it, the formats you need (paperback, hardcover, ebook), any images, and your target launch date.

questions.question: Which platforms will my files work on?
questions.answer: Files are prepared to the requirements of Amazon KDP and IngramSpark, and can also be used on platforms such as Apple Books, Barnes & Noble Press, Kobo, Lulu and Draft2Digital.

questions.question: What types of books do you work on?
questions.answer: Mainly nonfiction, self-help and personal development, children's books, workbooks, journals, educational materials and practical guides. I also consider fiction and other genres depending on the manuscript.

questions.question: What's the difference between proofreading and copy editing?
questions.answer: Proofreading is the final check for spelling, grammar, punctuation and typos. Copy editing goes deeper: it improves sentence structure, clarity and consistency while keeping your voice.

questions.question: Which languages do you translate?
questions.answer: I translate books from their original language into English, in American, British or Canadian English, depending on where your readers are. Send me a sample and I'll confirm the details in your quote.

questions.question: Do I keep the rights to my book?
questions.answer: Yes. Your manuscript and every file I deliver belong to you.
